data.reason_zh: LLM引导进化式改进模块化信号控制程序，以拥堵与运行反馈筛选保留，程序可迁移到其他场景。

scope_support.feedback_quote: EvoSignal improves programs through feedback on congestion and signal operation, retaining strategies with different performance trade-offs.
scope_support.object_quote: This paper formulates TSC as a modular program design problem and proposes EvoSignal, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework using traffic knowledge and performance feedback.
scope_support.persistence_quote: remains among the top three on each metric when transferred unchanged to the other four scenarios.
